title: Audio Storage Service (Cloudinary)
description: Cloud audio storage service using Cloudinary for secure call recording storage and playback. Features multipart upload handling, signed URL generation for secure access, automatic deletion, and retention policy support.
features: Cloudinary integration for audio file storage (stored as video resource type)
Multipart form upload handling with Express multer
Signed URL generation with configurable expiry (default 1 hour, max 24 hours)
Audio file deletion on call rejection
acceptance_criteria: Audio files upload to Cloudinary successfully
Signed URLs expire after specified time
Files can be deleted from cloud storage
result_summary: Complete audio storage service implemented with Cloudinary. Handles uploads, generates secure playback URLs, and manages file lifecycle. Integrated with staff call API endpoints. Production-ready with proper error handling.
